channel.title: Colorado Public Radio - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Colorado Public Radio (cpr.org)

item.title: Problem-solving students take on the shortage of teachers of color in Colorado
item.description: Northglenn High schoolers present evidence and data on how teacher diversity is a benefit to their education.

item.title: Cherry Creek schools superintendent resigns following ‘toxic culture’ investigation
item.description: The superintendent's wife is the chief human resource officer, which employs say created a conflict of interest.

item.title: Colorado Democrats want to expand the state’s red flag gun law, add new regulations on gun barrels
item.description: The proposals would add to the list of who can petition to have someone's guns removed under the state's red flag law and add new rules for selling and tracking gun barrels.

item.title: Broncos’ Bo Nix says his broken ankle won’t affect his offseason or hinder him once it heals
item.description: Bo Nix insists he'll remain the same dual-threat quarterback despite breaking his right ankle in the playoffs. The Denver Broncos quarterback says the injury was a simple break requiring a straightforward fix.

item.title: Pueblo District 60 board narrowly approves plan to merge six elementary schools into three facilities
item.description: About 1,800 students will be affected by the plan to address declining enrollment.

item.title: Construction begins on new space and defense technology facility at PuebloPlex
item.description: Denver-based Voyager Technologies is building a manufacturing, operations and testing complex.

item.title: New SafeSport CEO Fitzgerald Mosley wants to fix things quickly, saying ‘it’s a calling’
item.description: “It's a hard job,” Fitzgerald Mosley said in an interview with The Associated Press during a trip this week to agency headquarters in Denver.

item.title: Deadly crash along I-70 involving CDOT snowplow and youth hockey team
item.description: The driver of a sprinter van carrying members of the SC Flyers U12 girls hockey team from Santa Clarita, California, died. Their name has not been released.

item.title: Colorado signs up for federal scholarship program that could fund private education
item.description: Polis warns the U.S. Treasury Department of potential fraud and abuse and asks for more oversight.

item.title: Medicaid recipients, advocates furious over state mistake that’s costing tens of millions of dollars
item.description: This now threatens funding for programs supporting thousands of Colorado families with children with disabilities.
